type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {f : Polynomial ℤ} {P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ}
  {r : σ → ℕ} {A B β : ℝ} {s : ℕ},
  (∀ (i : ℕ), |↑(f.coeff i)| ≤ A) →
    (∀ (k : σ), degreeOf k P ≤ r k) →
      (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), |↑(P.coeff d)| ≤ B) →
        ∑ k : σ, r k ≤ s →
          2 ^ s ≤ β →
            (1 + A) ^ s ≤ β → ∀ (j : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : ℕ), |(Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) P) %ₘ f).coeff i| ≤ ↑⌊B * β ^ 3⌋₊
